        /// <summary>Converts a value read via GetValue to the property's type. See AUD-R25.</summary>
        private static T ReadFallback<T>(object value)
        {
            if (value is T typed)
                return typed;

            System.Type target = typeof(T);

            if (target.IsEnum)
            {
                return value is string enumText
                    ? (T)System.Enum.Parse(target, enumText, true)
                    : (T)System.Enum.ToObject(target, System.Convert.ChangeType(value, System.Enum.GetUnderlyingType(target), System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            }

            if (target == typeof(char) && value is string charText)
                return (T)(object)(charText.Length > 0 ? charText[0] : '\0');

        #if NET6_0_OR_GREATER
            if (target == typeof(System.DateOnly))
            {
                return (T)(object)(value is string dateText
                    ? System.DateOnly.Parse(dateText, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                    : System.DateOnly.FromDateTime(System.Convert.ToDateTime(value, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
            }

            if (target == typeof(System.TimeOnly))
            {
                if (value is string timeText)
                    return (T)(object)System.TimeOnly.Parse(timeText, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                if (value is System.TimeSpan timeSpan)
                    return (T)(object)System.TimeOnly.FromTimeSpan(timeSpan);
                return (T)(object)System.TimeOnly.FromDateTime(System.Convert.ToDateTime(value, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            }
        #endif

            // Convert.ChangeType cannot reach these - none of them is IConvertible-convertible
            // from string - and a provider on the IDataReader path may well hand back text.
            if (value is string text)
            {
                if (target == typeof(System.TimeSpan))
                    return (T)(object)System.TimeSpan.Parse(text, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                if (target == typeof(System.DateTimeOffset))
                    return (T)(object)System.DateTimeOffset.Parse(text, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                if (target == typeof(System.Guid))
                    return (T)(object)System.Guid.Parse(text);
            }

            if (target == typeof(System.DateTimeOffset) && value is System.DateTime dateTime)
                return (T)(object)new System.DateTimeOffset(dateTime);

            if (target == typeof(System.Guid) && value is byte[])
                throw new System.InvalidCastException(
                    $"Cannot convert a value of type '{value.GetType().FullName}' to '{target.FullName}'. " +
                    "If the provider returns this column as a byte array, map the property as byte[] and " +
                    "convert it yourself - the byte order of a binary GUID is provider-specific and Extrode.Jaunty " +
                    "will not guess it.");

            return (T)System.Convert.ChangeType(value, target, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        }

        private static void AddParam(IDbCommand cmd, IDataParameterCollection pc, string name, object? value)
        {
            var p = cmd.CreateParameter();
            p.ParameterName = name;
            // AUD-R30: route through the same type-handler/enum-storage conversion the
            // reflection binder applies, via the public bridge in Extrode.Jaunty core.
            p.Value = global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.ToDbValue(value) ?? DBNull.Value;
            pc.Add(p);
        }

        private static void AddEnumParam(IDbCommand cmd, IDataParameterCollection pc, string name, object? value, global::Extrode.Jaunty.Attributes.EnumStorage? storage)
        {
            var p = cmd.CreateParameter();
            p.ParameterName = name;
            p.Value = global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.ToDbEnumValue(value, storage) ?? DBNull.Value;
            pc.Add(p);
        }
        private static class OrdinalMap
        {
            private static readonly ConditionalWeakTable<IDataReader, CacheEntry> _cache = new();
#if !NET8_0_OR_GREATER
            private static readonly object _cacheWriteLock = new();
#endif
            [ThreadStatic]
            private static WeakReference<CacheEntry>? _last;

            public static CacheEntry Resolve(IDataReader reader)
            {
                var lastRef = _last;
                if (lastRef is not null && lastRef.TryGetTarget(out var last) && last.Matches(reader))
                    return last;

                if (_cache.TryGetValue(reader, out var cached) && cached.Matches(reader))
                {
                    SetLast(cached);
                    return cached;
                }

                var ords = new int[10];
                ords[0] = reader.GetOrdinal("id");
                ords[1] = reader.GetOrdinal("day");
                ords[2] = reader.GetOrdinal("moment");
                ords[3] = reader.GetOrdinal("duration");
                ords[4] = reader.GetOrdinal("occurred_at");
                ords[5] = reader.GetOrdinal("ref_id");
                ords[6] = reader.GetOrdinal("grade");
                ords[7] = reader.GetOrdinal("counter");
                ords[8] = reader.GetOrdinal("initial");
                ords[9] = reader.GetOrdinal("huge");
                var entry = new CacheEntry(reader, ords);
#if NET8_0_OR_GREATER
                _cache.AddOrUpdate(reader, entry);
#else
                lock (_cacheWriteLock)
                {
                    _cache.Remove(reader);
                    _cache.Add(reader, entry);
                }
#endif
                SetLast(entry);
                return entry;
            }

            private static void SetLast(CacheEntry entry)
            {
                var lastRef = _last;
                if (lastRef is null)
                    _last = new WeakReference<CacheEntry>(entry);
                else
                    lastRef.SetTarget(entry);
            }

            public sealed class CacheEntry
            {
                private readonly IDataReader _reader;
                private readonly int _fieldCount;

                public CacheEntry(IDataReader reader, int[] ordinals)
                {
                    _reader = reader;
                    _fieldCount = reader.FieldCount;
                    Ordinals = ordinals;
                }

                public int[] Ordinals { get; }

                public bool Matches(IDataReader reader)
                {
                    if (!ReferenceEquals(reader, _reader))
                        return false;

                    if (reader.FieldCount != _fieldCount)
                        return false;

                    var ord0 = Ordinals[0];
                    if ((uint)ord0 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord0), "id", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord1 = Ordinals[1];
                    if ((uint)ord1 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord1), "day", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord2 = Ordinals[2];
                    if ((uint)ord2 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord2), "moment", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord3 = Ordinals[3];
                    if ((uint)ord3 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord3), "duration", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord4 = Ordinals[4];
                    if ((uint)ord4 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord4), "occurred_at", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord5 = Ordinals[5];
                    if ((uint)ord5 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord5), "ref_id", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord6 = Ordinals[6];
                    if ((uint)ord6 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord6), "grade", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord7 = Ordinals[7];
                    if ((uint)ord7 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord7), "counter", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord8 = Ordinals[8];
                    if ((uint)ord8 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord8), "initial", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord9 = Ordinals[9];
                    if ((uint)ord9 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord9), "huge", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
